current.text: He has no starting role. The projected Knicks starters are Brunson, Bridges, Hart, Anunoby and Towns.
He projects as about the fifth man in the bench rotation. No fantasy impact is expected this season.
He had a very poor Summer League. He averaged 2 points, shot 7% from the field and made no two-pointers.

durable.text: He signed a 4-year contract worth 10 million USD.
Experts like him long term and see him as a possible future starting-caliber wing. That view matters for very deep dynasty leagues, not for this season.
In his small bench role he gives very little in points, rebounds and steals.
